approval.title: Allow “{tool}”?
approval.from_server: A tool of the MCP server {server}. It runs only if you allow it.
approval.builtin: A built-in tool. It runs only if you allow it.
approval.allowed_always: Allowed – this tool will not ask again (undo under Settings → Tools and connections)

activity.round_limit: The answer reached the limit of {n} tool rounds and uses what was found so far.

settings.title: Tools and connections
settings.subtitle: What models may use while they answer: built-in tools, a web search service and MCP servers. A call that changes something asks first; “Always allow” is offered only for small effects and can be undone at the end of this card.
settings.tools_hint: Offered to models that can call tools; never to models on this device or the site's free models.

switch.workspace_search: Search my files (the model may read passages of your files)
switch.memory_lookup: Memory (facts you asked the assistant to remember)
switch.web_search: Web search tool (the model searches on its own with the service below)
switch.generate_image: Create images (asks before each image; uses your OpenAI, Google or xAI key)

settings.search_hint: For models without a search of their own: with Web switched on, Starpi searches the question, the model answers from the results, and the answer is checked against them.

search.url_hint: The address of your instance; its JSON output must be switched on.
search.relay_note: Brave Search does not answer browser calls; it is reached through this site's relay, which forwards the request and keeps nothing.
search.bad_url: This is not a usable address.

settings.mcp_hint: Servers that offer tools over MCP (Streamable HTTP). The browser can reach a server only when it allows calls from this page. You approve each tool once; after that every call asks, unless you chose “Always allow” for a tool that only reads or has a small effect. A tool whose definition changes must be approved again and asks again.
settings.remembered_hint: Tools you chose “Always allow” for run without asking. Forget a choice here and the tool asks again.

mcp.name: Name
mcp.url: Address (https, or http on this computer)
mcp.remember: Keep the token in the key vault
mcp.bad_url_provider: A provider can only reach a public https address.
mcp.schema: Arguments as the model sees them
mcp.provider_flag_hint: For servers that block browser calls: Anthropic or OpenAI connects to the server instead and calls the tools you list without asking each time. Only for public https servers you trust.
mcp.provider_note: Called by the provider; the listed tools run without asking.

error.cors: the server does not allow calls from this page
error.http: the server answered with an error
